rule: flag = plane_u8 >= level, per plane and per band (r9_e1_eval.MapThresholds); a plane absent here keeps the fixed 128

criterion.name: PER PLANE (see per_plane): iou = one-vs-rest, per plane and per band: the uint8 level that maximises the pooled IoU of {plane >= level} against the plane's GT class(es) over GT-valid cells (gt != 255); first level on ties (refit_perception_thresholds.best_threshold); level 0 is never emitted; f_tol = thin-class rule of E0d (REFCV9_DESIGN 2.1; e0d_score.py _edge_stats / fit_grid_threshold): the uint8 level in 1..255 that maximises the pooled F@0.3 m = 2PR/(P+R) of {pedge >= level} vs GT class 5 over the band's rows; R = |GT5 & dilate(flag, 3)| / |GT5|, P = |flag & judged & dilate(GT5, 3)| / |flag & judged|, judged = gt != 255 and gt != 0; square 3-cell element, zero padding, dilation on the whole raster; first level on ties; a band with no GT edge cell (or with F = 0 at every level) is refused

psw.definition: one-vs-rest, per plane and per band: the uint8 level that maximises the pooled IoU of {plane >= level} against the plane's GT class(es) over GT-valid cells (gt != 255); first level on ties (refit_perception_thresholds.best_threshold); level 0 is never emitted

pedge.definition: thin-class rule of E0d (REFCV9_DESIGN 2.1; e0d_score.py _edge_stats / fit_grid_threshold): the uint8 level in 1..255 that maximises the pooled F@0.3 m = 2PR/(P+R) of {pedge >= level} vs GT class 5 over the band's rows; R = |GT5 & dilate(flag, 3)| / |GT5|, P = |flag & judged & dilate(GT5, 3)| / |flag & judged|, judged = gt != 255 and gt != 0; square 3-cell element, zero padding, dilation on the whole raster; first level on ties; a band with no GT edge cell (or with F = 0 at every level) is refused

fit.rule: TRAIN clips; K windows per clip at ts[int((j + 0.5) * len(ts) / K)] of the dataset's sorted starts (run_diag.py train_diag)

provenance.caveat: bound to THIS checkpoint's planes: valid for this model's rasters only; fitted on TRAIN clips (the arm may have trained on them: the FIT operating point is then optimistic, as for the 8-way refits); one seed
